answer.en: Only a little, and ask your vet first. The AKC lists yogurt or kefir with live cultures among the foods a vet may suggest to boost beneficial bacteria, but many dogs have trouble digesting lactose. Never give kefir with xylitol or other artificial sweeteners.
answer.sl: Le malo in najprej vprašajte veterinarja. AKC jogurt ali kefir z živimi kulturami navaja med živili, ki jih lahko veterinar predlaga za krepitev koristnih bakterij, vendar mnogi psi težko prebavljajo laktozo. Nikoli ne dajajte kefirja s ksilitolom ali drugimi umetnimi sladili.

why.en: Many dogs have trouble digesting foods that contain lactose; a dog's body isn't designed to digest lactose after puppyhood, so it can cause gas and other tummy trouble. Some dogs can also develop an allergy to milk protein. Some artificial sweeteners, such as xylitol, are toxic to dogs, so kefir with artificial sweeteners is a risk.
why.sl: Mnogi psi težko prebavljajo živila, ki vsebujejo laktozo; pasje telo po obdobju mladička ni narejeno za prebavo laktoze, zato lahko povzroči vetrove in druge težave s trebuhom. Pri nekaterih psih se lahko razvije tudi alergija na mlečne beljakovine. Nekatera umetna sladila, na primer ksilitol, so za pse strupena, zato je kefir z umetnimi sladili tvegan.

what_to_do.en: As with yogurt, offer a small amount at first and see how your dog reacts. If your dog gets loose stools, gas, vomiting or diarrhoea, stop the kefir. Ask your vet whether probiotic foods suit your dog.
what_to_do.sl: Kot pri jogurtu najprej ponudite majhno količino in opazujte, kako se pes odzove. Če ima pes mehko blato, vetrove, bruha ali ima drisko, kefirja ne dajajte več. Veterinarja vprašajte, ali so probiotična živila primerna za vašega psa.

serving.en: Choose plain kefir and read the label carefully to avoid all artificial sweeteners, especially xylitol. Start with a small amount.
serving.sl: Izberite navaden kefir in natančno preberite deklaracijo, da se izognete vsem umetnim sladilom, predvsem ksilitolu. Začnite z majhno količino.

child.en: Some dogs can have a tiny taste of plain kefir, but many get a sore tummy from milk drinks. Fresh water is always best!
child.sl: Nekateri psi lahko poskusijo čisto malo navadnega kefirja, mnoge pa od mlečnih pijač boli trebušček. Sveža voda je vedno najboljša!

q.en: Is kefir a good probiotic for dogs?
q.sl: Ali je kefir dober probiotik za pse?

a.en: The AKC lists yogurt or kefir with live cultures among the options a vet may suggest to boost beneficial bacteria. Ask your vet before adding it to your dog's diet.
a.sl: AKC jogurt ali kefir z živimi kulturami navaja med možnostmi, ki jih lahko veterinar predlaga za krepitev koristnih bakterij. Preden ga dodate v pasji jedilnik, vprašajte veterinarja.

sources.quote: your veterinarian may suggest using these helpful tools to boost beneficial bacteria:
Yogurt or kefir with live cultures.
Only offer your dog unsweetened, plain yogurt, and read labels carefully to avoid all artificial sweeteners.
many dogs have trouble digesting foods that contain lactose
Dogs' bodies aren't designed to digest lactose after puppyhood
some artificial sweeteners, such as xylitol, are toxic to dogs.
feed your dog a small amount at first and see how they react.
Some dogs can tolerate very small amounts of lactose in milk but they can also develop an allergy to the milk protein
Dogs can have varying degrees of lactose intolerance; some might experience only mild symptoms, while other cases may be more severe.
Dogs only need to drink fresh water daily.
